dedupe_keys.name: latvia third cycle flood hazard and flood risk maps 2026 to 2031 spring flood storm surge and ice jam extents at 10 1 and 0 5 probability

description: The Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre publishes the third-cycle flood maps prepared under the EU Floods Directive for the planning period 2026 to 2031. Contents: outer boundaries of potentially flooded areas for three return probabilities (10%, 1% and 0.5%) and three flood types, namely spring snowmelt floods on rivers, wind-driven sea storm surges on the coast and the Gulf of Riga, and ice jam flooding, for the river and coastal stretches where modelling was done; flood damage sites and flood risk maps accompany the hazard layers. Producer: LVĢMC, the national hydrometeorological and environment agency. Coverage: the areas of potentially significant flood risk in Latvia, mainly the Daugava, Lielupe, Gauja and Venta basins and the coast, not the whole country. Format and access: three WMS services on the ĢEOLatvija.lv platform, refreshed about once a year; the flood extent datasets with water depth classes are paid information obtained from the LVĢMC client centre. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 for the published map services. Caveats: the open part is extents only, as map images; depth grids and vector extents cost money; modelled reaches only. Simulation uses: flood exposure of roads, railways, substations and water utilities, coastal surge scenarios for Riga and Jūrmala, and stress-testing infrastructure plans against 1% and 0.5% events. Related records: LVĢMC hydrological forecasts (data-lvgmc-latvia-hydrological-forecasts) give the river level forecasts from the same centre.
